nodes.name: Norman Conquest
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Conquest of England initiated by William, Duke of Normandy; includes the Battle of Hastings and subsequent consolidation of Norman rule.

nodes.name: Sealing of Magna Carta (1215)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: King John sealed Magna Carta, limiting royal power and establishing foundational legal rights.

nodes.name: Black Death in England
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Arrival and spread of the Black Death, killing roughly half the population and driving major economic and social upheaval.

nodes.name: Act of Supremacy (1534) Passed
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Parliament passed the Act of Supremacy (1534), breaking England away from the Roman Catholic Church and asserting royal supremacy.

nodes.name: Defeat of the Spanish Armada (1588)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Defeat of the Spanish Armada strengthened England's naval reputation and altered the European balance of power.

nodes.name: Gunpowder Plot (1605)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Failed attempt to blow up the House of Lords at Westminster; plot was discovered and the conspirators were arrested.

nodes.name: Great Fire of London (1666)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Fire that destroyed much of the City of London, reshaping the city's built environment and governance.

nodes.name: Glorious Revolution (1688)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Political settlement that established parliamentary supremacy over the crown and affirmed key constitutional principles.

nodes.name: Acts of Union (1707)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Acts passed by the English and Scottish parliaments uniting England and Scotland as the Kingdom of Great Britain.

nodes.name: Industrial Revolution in Britain
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Period of rapid industrialization and technological change that transformed Britain into the world's first industrial power.

nodes.name: Slave Trade Act (1807)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Act of Parliament that abolished the British slave trade, marking a major shift in imperial law and enforcement.

nodes.name: United Kingdom Home Front (World War I)
nodes.label: Event
nodes.description: Mobilization, rationing, industrial expansion, and social change within the United Kingdom during World War I.
